name: Hong Kong
officialName: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

flag.description: A red field with a stylised white five-petalled bauhinia flower in the centre, each petal carrying a small red five-pointed star.
flag.symbolism: Red is the colour of the Chinese national flag and the white bauhinia stands for Hong Kong, so the two colours together express "one country, two systems"; the stars echo those on China's flag.

hook: Hong Kong is a white bauhinia flower on red, each of its five petals holding a red star; Macau swaps it for a white lotus on green.
trivia: The flag was first raised officially at midnight on 1 July 1997, at the ceremony handing Hong Kong from the United Kingdom to China.
The flower, Bauhinia × blakeana, is a sterile hybrid first found in Hong Kong and can only be grown from cuttings or grafts.
